create_tabular_policy: create a TabularPolicy from a game with explicit state-action probability arrays
create_uniform_random_policy: create a UniformRandomPolicy that samples uniformly over all legal actions
create_first_action_policy: create a FirstActionPolicy that always selects the lowest-numbered legal action
sample_action_from_policy: sample an action from a policy given a game state and optional player id
merge_tabular_policies: merge per-player TabularPolicies into a single joint TabularPolicy
